name: Tip the Helper
author: Sajjad Hossain Sagor

sections.description:
“Tip The Helper” is a seamless WooCommerce add-on that allows customers to show appreciation to drivers, delivery personnel, servers, or any service provider with an optional tip during checkout. Perfect for food delivery, ride services, local businesses, and more—this plugin makes gratitude effortless!

Features

  • Flexible Tipping Options – Set fixed amounts, percentages, or custom tip values.
  • Who to Tip? – Let customers choose who gets the tip (Driver, Server, Helper, etc.).
  • Checkout Integration – Adds a smooth tipping field to the WooCommerce checkout page.
  • Customizable Messages – Encourage tipping with friendly prompts like “Thank your driver!”
  • Tip Reporting – Track tips in WooCommerce orders and export data for accounting.
  • Mobile-Friendly – Works perfectly on all devices.
  • Multi-Currency Support – Compatible with WooCommerce currency switchers.

Why Use Tip The Helper?

Boost Earnings for Workers – Give customers an easy way to reward great service.

Increase Customer Satisfaction – A small gesture that enhances the shopping experience.

Lightweight & Easy Setup – No complex settings—just install and go!

Ideal for

🍕 Food Delivery Stores | 🚚 Courier Services | 🏪 Local Shops | � Any WooCommerce Store with Helpers!

Install “Tip The Helper” today and let kindness checkout with every order!
sections.installation:
1. Go to WordPress plugin page
  2. Click Add New & Upload Plugin
  3. Drag / Click upload the plugin zip file
  4. The resulting installation screen will list the installation as successful or note any problems during the install. If successful, click Activate Plugin to activate it, or Return to Plugin Installer for further actions.
  5. Go to your Dashboard -> Tip The Helper.
  6. There You Will Find Fields To Customize the tipping options.
sections.faq:
How does “Tip The Helper” work?

The plugin adds a customizable tipping field during WooCommerce checkout. Customers can enter a tip amount (fixed, percentage, or custom value) and optionally select who the tip is for (e.g., driver, server). The tip is added to the order total and recorded for reporting.

Can I set default tip amounts?

Yes! In the plugin settings, you can:
– Offer preset amounts (e.g., $2, $5, $10)
– Allow percentage-based tips (e.g., 5%, 10%, 15%)
– Enable custom tips (users enter any amount)

How are tips processed?

Tips are included in the WooCommerce order total and processed as part of the payment. You can:
– Assign tips to staff manually
– Use reports to track and distribute tips

Can customers decline to tip?

Absolutely! Tipping is optional by default. You can toggle this in settings.

Can I customize the tipping message?

Yes! Edit the text in settings, e.g.:
– “Thank your driver! Add a tip?”
– “Support our team with a gratuity”
